# anthropic_analytics_cost_report (Data Source)

Cost over time across Claude products for a Claude Enterprise organization (usage-based plans; seat-based plans report usage credits only). Amounts are fractional cents as decimal strings. Data is available from 2026-01-01 with about a one-day lag; the API allows 60 requests per minute per organization. Requires `analytics_api_key` (or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying `read:analytics`).

~> This is a point-in-time report that is re-read on every plan. Use it for outputs and policy checks, not to manage infrastructure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Daily cost by cost type for one month; amounts are fractional cents.
data "anthropic_analytics_cost_report" "month" {
  starting_at = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  ending_at   = "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z"
  group_by    = ["cost_type"]
}

output "month_cost_usd" {
  value = tonumber(data.anthropic_analytics_cost_report.month.total_amount) / 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `starting_at` (String) Inclusive start, RFC 3339. No earlier than 2026-01-01 and within the last 365 days.

### Optional

- `bucket_width` (String) Bucket granularity: `1d` (default), `1h` or `1m`.
- `claude_tag_categories` (List of String) Restrict to these Claude Tag categories.
- `claude_tag_user_ids` (List of String) Restrict to these Slack user ids (Claude Tag).
- `context_windows` (List of String) Restrict to these context windows.
- `ending_at` (String) Exclusive end, RFC 3339. Defaults to now; the range may span at most 31 days.
- `group_by` (List of String) Dimensions to break each bucket out by.
- `inference_geos` (List of String) Restrict to these inference geographies.
- `models` (List of String) Restrict to these model names.
- `products` (List of String) Restrict to these products.
- `rbac_group_ids` (List of String) Restrict to members of these RBAC groups.
- `slack_channel_ids` (List of String) Restrict to these Slack channel ids (Claude Tag).
- `speeds` (List of String) Restrict to these speeds.
- `user_ids` (List of String) Restrict to these users (`user_...`).

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) Time buckets, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))
- `data_refreshed_at` (String) When the underlying export was refreshed; data after it may be incomplete.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization id.
- `total_amount` (String) Sum of every `amount`, fractional cents with six decimals.
- `total_list_amount` (String) Sum of every `list_amount`, fractional cents with six decimals.

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `ending_at` (String) Bucket end (exclusive).
- `results` (Attributes List) One row per group within the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets--results))
- `starting_at` (String) Bucket start (inclusive).

<a id="nestedatt--buckets--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets.results`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Post-discount cost in fractional cents as a decimal string.
- `claude_tag_category` (String) Dimension `claude_tag_category`; null unless grouped by it.
- `claude_tag_user_id` (String) Dimension `claude_tag_user_id`; null unless grouped by it.
- `context_window` (String) Dimension `context_window`; null unless grouped by it.
- `cost_type` (String) `tokens`, `web_search` or `code_execution`; null unless grouped by `cost_type`.
- `currency` (String) Currency code, always `USD`.
- `inference_geo` (String) Dimension `inference_geo`; null unless grouped by it.
- `list_amount` (String) List-price cost in fractional cents as a decimal string.
- `model` (String) Dimension `model`; null unless grouped by it.
- `product` (String) Dimension `product`; null unless grouped by it.
- `rbac_group_id` (String) Dimension `rbac_group_id`; null unless grouped by it.
- `requests` (Number) Request count; null when grouped by `cost_type` or `token_type`.
- `slack_channel_id` (String) Dimension `slack_channel_id`; null unless grouped by it.
- `speed` (String) Dimension `speed`; null unless grouped by it.
- `token_type` (String) Token type; null unless grouped by `token_type`.
